title: Ish va karyera lug‘ati
goal_uz: Dars oxirida karyera kolokatsiyalarini to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz, yutuqlaringizni raqam va kuchli fe’llar bilan tasvirlaysiz, ish joyida muloyim muloqot qilasiz va rasmiy elektron xat yoza olasiz.

scenes.title: Ish va karyera tili
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda shart gaplarni, afsus va qarorlar haqida gapirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun bu bilimni ish dunyosiga olib kiramiz. Karyera lug‘ati, yutuqlarni tasvirlash, ish joyidagi muloqot va rasmiy elektron xat. Dars oxirida o‘zingizni mutaxassis sifatida aniq va ishonchli tanishtira olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we build the language of work: careers, achievements, workplace communication and formal emails.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun ish tilini o‘rganamiz: karyera, yutuqlar, ish joyidagi muloqot va rasmiy xatlar.

scenes.title: Job, work, career, position

examples.t: I'm looking for a new job.
She has a successful career in law.
examples.uz: U huquq sohasida muvaffaqiyatli karyera qilgan.

scenes.say_native: Bu to‘rt so‘z o‘zbekchada “ish” bo‘lib qoladi. Job sanaladigan so‘z: a job, two jobs. Work sanalmaydi: ko‘p ish, mehnat. Career bu yillar davomidagi kasbiy yo‘l, ishlar ketma-ketligi. Position yoki post esa tashkilotdagi aniq lavozim, vakansiya e’lonlarida shunday yoziladi. Occupation rasmiy anketalarda kasb nomi uchun ishlatiladi. Bu farqni bilsangiz, nutqingiz darrov professionalroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: A job is one specific position. Work is general activity. A career is the path of your working life.
scenes.say_uz: Job bu aniq lavozim. Work umumiy faoliyat. Career bu ish hayotingiz yo‘li.

scenes.title: A work emas
board: ✗ I have a work in a bank.
✓ I have a job in a bank.
✗ I have a lot of works to do.
✓ I have a lot of work to do.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: “a work” va “works”. O‘zbekchada “ish” ni sanash mumkin, ingliz tilida esa work sanalmaydi, unda ko‘plik va a yo‘q. “Many works” faqat san’at asarlari haqida ishlatiladi, masalan Shekspir asarlari. Ish joyini nazarda tutsangiz, a job deng. Qo‘shimcha ravishda, “I work in a bank” va “I have a job at a bank” ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Work is uncountable. I have a lot of work. For one position, say a job.
scenes.say_uz: Work sanalmaydi. Ishim juda ko‘p. Bitta lavozim uchun a job deng.

scenes.title: Ishga olinish: kolokatsiyalar
board: apply for a job / a position
be offered a job → accept / turn down

examples.t: She applied for the post and was shortlisted.
examples.uz: U lavozimga hujjat topshirdi va qisqa ro‘yxatga kirdi.

examples.t: He handed in his notice last Friday.
examples.uz: U o‘tgan juma kuni ishdan ketish haqida xabar berdi.

scenes.say_native: Endi kolokatsiyalar, ya’ni birga keladigan so‘zlar. Ish uchun “apply for” deymiz, apply to emas, ya’ni apply for a job, apply to a company. Keyin ariza ko‘rib chiqiladi, siz shortlisted bo‘lsangiz, suhbatga chaqirilasiz. Taklif kelsa, uni qabul qilasiz yoki rad etasiz: accept yoki turn down. Ketmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, hand in your notice, ya’ni oldindan ogohlantirasiz, so‘ng resign qilasiz. Ishdan bo‘shatish haqida: sacked yoki fired jazo sifatida, made redundant lavozim qisqarganda.
scenes.say: You apply for a job, attend an interview, accept an offer, and hand in your notice when you resign.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga ariza topshirasiz, suhbatga borasiz, taklifni qabul qilasiz, ketayotganda esa ogohlantirish xatini topshirasiz.

scenes.title: Karyera o‘sishi

examples.t: He climbed the career ladder quickly.
I'm considering a career change.

scenes.say_native: Karyera o‘sishi haqida iboralar. Climb the career ladder, ya’ni zinapoyadan ko‘tarilish. Get promoted, lavozimda ko‘tarilish, promotion esa shu ko‘tarilishning nomi. Take on more responsibility, ko‘proq mas’uliyat olish. Career break ishdan bir muddat chetlashish, masalan farzand parvarishi uchun. Change careers butunlay boshqa sohaga o‘tish. Britaniyada ish haqining oshishi “pay rise”, Amerikada esa “raise”. Yana work-life balance, ya’ni ish va shaxsiy hayot muvozanati.
scenes.say: You can climb the career ladder, get promoted and take on more responsibility. British English says pay rise; American English says raise.
scenes.say_uz: Karyera zinapoyasidan ko‘tarilishingiz, lavozimingiz oshishi va mas’uliyat olishingiz mumkin. Britaniyada pay rise, Amerikada raise.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri kolokatsiyalar
board: ✗ I took a promotion. ✓ I got promoted.
✗ I did an interview. ✓ I had an interview.
✗ I make overtime. ✓ I work overtime.
✗ apply to a job ✓ apply for a job
scenes.say_native: Ona tilidan tarjima qilingan kolokatsiyalar eng qiyin xato manbasi. “Promotion oldim” deb tarjima qilib “took a promotion” deyilmaydi, to‘g‘risi “I got promoted” yoki “I was promoted”. Suhbat “do” bilan emas, “have an interview” yoki “go for an interview”. Qo‘shimcha ish soati “work overtime”. Ariza esa apply for. Kolokatsiyani doim butun ibora sifatida yodlang, bitta so‘zni alohida emas.
scenes.say: Learn collocations as whole phrases: get promoted, have an interview, work overtime, apply for a job.
scenes.say_uz: Kolokatsiyalarni butun ibora sifatida yodlang: get promoted, have an interview, work overtime, apply for a job.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri fe’lni tanlang
board: 1) She ___ for the manager's post. (applied / made)
2) He was ___ last year after five years. (promoted / taken)
3) I'd like to ___ my notice. (hand in / do)
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda to‘g‘ri fe’lni tanlang. Birinchi: u menejer lavozimiga ariza topshirdi. Ikkinchi: u besh yildan keyin o‘tgan yili lavozimda ko‘tarildi. Uchinchi: men ishdan ketish haqida ogohlantirish xatini topshirmoqchiman. Qavs ichidagi variantlardan birini tanlang.
scenes.say: One: applied or made? Two: promoted or taken? Three: hand in or do? Choose the correct verb.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: applied yoki made? Ikki: promoted yoki taken? Uch: hand in yoki do? To‘g‘ri fe’lni tanlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: applied, chunki apply for the post kolokatsiya. Ikkinchi: promoted, chunki lavozim ko‘tarilishi be promoted shaklida passiv ishlatiladi. Uchinchi: hand in my notice. Bu uchta ibora ishga kirish, o‘sish va ketish bosqichlarini qamrab oladi. Ularni bir hikoyaga bog‘lab ayting: I applied, I was promoted, and now I'm handing in my notice.
scenes.say: She applied for the post. He was promoted last year. I'd like to hand in my notice.
scenes.say_uz: U lavozimga ariza topshirdi. U o‘tgan yili lavozimda ko‘tarildi. Ishdan ketish haqida xabar bermoqchiman.

scenes.title: Ish haqi va shartnoma turlari

examples.t: She earns a good salary.
He works freelance for several clients.
examples.uz: U bir nechta mijoz uchun frilanser sifatida ishlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Ish haqi uchun bir nechta so‘z bor. Salary bu belgilangan oylik yoki yillik maosh, ofis ishlarida. Wage soatbay yoki haftalik to‘lov. Pay umumiy so‘z. Income esa barcha daromadingiz. Shartnoma turlari: permanent, ya’ni doimiy, temporary yoki fixed-term, muddatli, freelance esa mijozlar bilan alohida ishlash. Full-time to‘liq ish kuni, part-time qisman. Britaniyada annual leave, Amerikada vacation deyiladi.
scenes.say: A salary is paid monthly. A wage is often paid hourly. You can be permanent, temporary or freelance.
scenes.say_uz: Salary oylik to‘lanadi. Wage ko‘pincha soatbay. Siz doimiy, vaqtinchalik yoki frilanser bo‘lishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Ish fe’llari: phrasal verbs
board: take on · carry out · set up
deal with · look into · get back to

examples.t: I'll look into it and get back to you.
examples.uz: Buni o'rganib chiqaman va sizga javob qaytaraman.

examples.t: She stepped down as CEO.

scenes.say_native: Ish joyida phrasal verb lar juda ko‘p. Take on, ya’ni mas’uliyat yoki ishni zimmaga olish. Carry out, vazifani bajarish. Set up, yangi narsani tashkil qilish. Hand over, topshirish. Step down, lavozimni tark etish. Deal with, muammo bilan shug‘ullanish. Look into, masalani o‘rganib chiqish, get back to someone esa keyinroq javob qaytarish. Muhim: hand over it emas, hand it over, chunki olmosh fe’l bilan particle o‘rtasida turadi.
scenes.say: I'll look into it and get back to you. She stepped down. Can you hand it over to Tom?
scenes.say_uz: Buni o‘rganib chiqib, sizga javob qaytaraman. U lavozimdan ketdi. Buni Tomga topshira olasizmi?

scenes.title: Phrasal verb tanlang
board: 1) I need to ___ a new team. (set up / look into)
2) Can you ___ this to Anna? (hand over / deal with it)
3) She will ___ in June. (step down / carry on it)
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni to‘ldiring. Yangi jamoa tuzish uchun qaysi fe’l mos? Hujjatni Annaga topshirish uchun nima? Va iyunda lavozimdan ketadigan odam haqida qaysi ibora to‘g‘ri? Javobni ayting.
scenes.say: One: set up or look into? Two: hand over or deal with? Three: step down or carry on?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: set up yoki look into? Ikki: hand over yoki deal with? Uch: step down yoki carry on?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Jamoa tuzish uchun “set up a new team”. Hujjatni topshirish uchun “hand over this to Anna”, olmosh bilan esa “hand it over to Anna”. Lavozimdan ketish uchun “step down”. Bu fe’llarni kundalik ish gaplarida ishlatishga harakat qiling, chunki ish tilida ular rasmiy sinonimlardan ko‘ra tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: I need to set up a new team. Can you hand this over to Anna? She will step down in June.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi jamoa tuzishim kerak. Buni Annaga topshira olasizmi? U iyunda lavozimdan ketadi.

scenes.title: Yutuqlarni tasvirlash: kuchli fe’llar

examples.t: I led a team of eight engineers.
examples.uz: Men sakkiz muhandisdan iborat jamoani boshqardim.

examples.t: We launched the product in three markets.
examples.uz: Biz mahsulotni uchta bozorda ishga tushirdik.

scenes.say_native: CV va suhbatda yutuqlarni tasvirlash uchun kuchli harakat fe’llari kerak. Responsible for o‘rniga led, managed, launched, developed, negotiated kabi fe’llardan foydalaning. Natija haqida: increased, reduced, improved, delivered. Bu fe’llar o‘tgan oddiy zamonda keladi, chunki tugagan ishlar haqida gap ketyapti. Ular sizni passiv ishchi emas, faol natija yaratgan odam sifatida ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: I led a team, launched a product and negotiated a major contract. Use strong action verbs.
scenes.say_uz: Men jamoani boshqardim, mahsulot ishga tushirdim va yirik shartnoma bo‘yicha muzokara olib bordim. Kuchli fe’llardan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Raqamlar bilan: by, to, from

examples.t: Sales rose by 20%.
Costs fell from 90 to 70 thousand.

scenes.say_native: Raqamli natija ishonchlilikni oshiradi. Preposition lar ma’noni o‘zgartiradi. By o‘zgarish miqdorini bildiradi: sales increased by twenty per cent. To yakuniy qiymatni: increased to five million. From va to birgalikda boshlanish va oxirini: from three million to five million. O‘zbekchada “20 foizga oshdi” va “5 millionga yetdi” ikkala holatda ham “ga” qo‘shimchasi bo‘ladi, shuning uchun ularni chalkashtirish oson.
scenes.say: Sales rose by twenty per cent, from three million to five million.
scenes.say_uz: Sotuv yigirma foizga, uch milliondan besh millionga oshdi.

scenes.title: Responsible va by/to xatolari
board: ✗ I was responsible of the budget.
✓ I was responsible for the budget.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: responsible of. To‘g‘ri: responsible for, undan keyin ot yoki -ing shakli: responsible for managing the budget. Ikkinchisi: increased with. Bu rus yoki o‘zbek tilidan tarjima izi. Miqdor uchun by, yakuniy qiymat uchun to. Yana bir ehtiyot: “in charge of” ham to‘g‘ri, lekin “in charge for” emas. Preposition larni juftlikda yodlang.
scenes.say: Say responsible for, in charge of, and increased by ten per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Responsible for, in charge of va increased by ten per cent deng.

scenes.title: Qanday gapirish: STAR usuli

examples.t: Our sales were falling. I redesigned the strategy. Revenue grew by 15%.
examples.uz: Sotuvimiz tushayotgan edi. Men strategiyani qayta ishlab chiqdim. Daromad 15 foizga oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Suhbatda yutuq haqida gapirishning yaxshi usuli STAR: situation, task, action, result. Vaziyat, vazifa, sizning harakatingiz va natija. Harakat va natijani o‘tgan oddiy zamonda aytasiz. Agar yutuq hozir ham amalda bo‘lsa, present perfect: I have managed twelve projects, ya’ni tajribam hali ham davom etmoqda. Muhim: o‘zingizni maqtashda ham muvozanat saqlang. “I contributed to” va “I played a key role in” iboralari ishonchli, lekin dabdabasiz eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Describe the situation, your task, your action and the result. I played a key role in the project, and I have managed twelve projects so far.
scenes.say_uz: Vaziyat, vazifa, harakat va natijani tasvirlang. Men loyihada muhim rol o‘ynadim va hozirgacha o‘n ikkita loyihani boshqarganman.

scenes.title: Yutuqni qayta yozing
board: 1) I was responsible for training new staff.
2) Our website got more visitors because of me.
3) I helped with a big contract.
scenes.say_native: Uchta zaif gapni kuchli yutuqqa aylantiring. Birinchi: yangi xodimlarni o‘qitish uchun mas’ul edim. Ikkinchi: veb-saytimizga mening sababimdan ko‘proq tashrif buyuruvchi keldi. Uchinchi: katta shartnomaga yordam berdim. Har birida kuchli fe’l ishlating va iloji bo‘lsa, raqam qo‘shing.
scenes.say: Rewrite each weak sentence with a strong verb. Add a number if you can.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir zaif gapni kuchli fe’l bilan qayta yozing. Iloji bo‘lsa, raqam qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) I trained 20 new members of staff.
3) I helped negotiate a £2 million contract.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. “I trained twenty new members of staff.” “I increased website traffic by forty per cent.” “I helped negotiate a two million pound contract.” Sizning variantlaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin asosiy qoida bir: bevosita kuchli fe’l, aniq raqam, aniq natija. Raqamni to‘qimang: haqiqiy ma’lumotlardan foydalaning.
scenes.say: I trained twenty new members of staff. I increased website traffic by forty per cent. I helped negotiate a two million pound contract.
scenes.say_uz: Men yigirma yangi xodimni o‘qitdim. Men sayt trafigini qirq foizga oshirdim. Men ikki million funtlik shartnoma bo‘yicha muzokaraga yordam berdim.

scenes.title: Ishingiz haqida gapirish
board: I've been working here for six years.
I'm in charge of ... · I report to ...

examples.t: I've been working here since 2019.
I report to the head of sales.

scenes.say_native: Ish haqida gapirganda hozirgi zamonni to‘g‘ri tanlang. Kasb: I work as an accountant. Ish davomiyligi: I've been working here for six years yoki since 2019, ya’ni present perfect continuous, for bilan muddat, since bilan boshlanish payti. O‘zbekchada “olti yildan beri ishlayman” deymiz va hozirgi zamondan foydalanamiz, inglizchada I work here for six years noto‘g‘ri. Mas’uliyat: I'm in charge of. Rahbar: I report to.
scenes.say: I work as an accountant. I've been working here for six years. I'm in charge of the budget, and I report to the finance director.
scenes.say_uz: Men buxgalter bo‘lib ishlayman. Bu yerda olti yildan beri ishlayman. Byudjet uchun mas’ulman va moliya direktoriga bo‘ysunaman.

scenes.title: Yig‘ilishda gapirish
board: Let's get started. · Shall we begin?
Let's circle back to that. · Action points

examples.t: I see your point, but I have a concern.
Let's agree on the action points.

scenes.say_native: Ish yig‘ilishlarida tayyor iboralar vaqtingizni tejaydi va sizni ishonchli ko‘rsatadi. Boshlash uchun “Let's get started”. Gapga qo‘shilish uchun “Can I add something?” Rozi bo‘lmaslik uchun “I see your point, but ...”, ya’ni avval tushunganingizni bildirasiz, keyin e’tiroz. Mavzudan chiqib ketsangiz, “Let's circle back to that”. Oxirida action points, ya’ni kim nima qiladi, deadline va follow-up bilan. Bu mantiq siz uchun ham foyda, ham hurmat.
scenes.say: Let's get started. I see your point, but I have a concern. Let's agree on the action points.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlaylik. Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin xavotirim bor. Keyingi qadamlarni kelishib olaylik.

scenes.title: Muloyim so‘rov va rad etish
board: Unfortunately, I won't be able to ...

examples.t: Would you mind sending me the report?
I was wondering if we could move the deadline.
examples.uz: Muddatni surishimiz mumkin emasmikan deb o‘ylagan edim.

scenes.say_native: Ish joyida buyruq o‘rniga muloyim so‘rov ishlatiladi. “Could you possibly ...?”, “Would you mind sending ...?”, undan keyin -ing shakli, “I was wondering if we could ...”. Rad etishda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri “No” emas, “Unfortunately, I won't be able to ...” deymiz va sabab yoki muqobil taklif qo‘shamiz. O‘zbek tilida “iltimos” so‘zi yetarli bo‘ladi, inglizcha esa tuzilmaning o‘zi muloyimlikni bildiradi, shuning uchun faqat “please” qo‘shish yetarli emas.
scenes.say: Would you mind sending me the report? I was wondering if we could move the deadline.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotni yuborishingizga qarshi bo‘lmaysizmi? Muddatni surishimiz mumkin emasmikan deb o‘ylagan edim.

scenes.title: Juda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri
board: ✓ Could you send me the report today?
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p o‘zbek o‘quvchilar buyruq shaklini, masalan “Give me the report” yoki “You must”, ish joyida ishlatadi, chunki ona tilida “iltimos” bilan bu normal eshitiladi. Ingliz tilida bu qo‘pol yoki buyruq tonida eshitiladi, hatto please bilan ham. Buning o‘rniga savol shakli: “Could you send me ...?”. Ehtiyoj haqida: “I'd really appreciate your help”. Ohang va tuzilma ish munosabatlarini saqlaydi.
scenes.say: Use questions, not commands. Could you send me the report? I'd appreciate your help.
scenes.say_uz: Buyruq emas, savol shaklidan foydalaning. Hisobotni yuborishingiz mumkinmi? Yordamingiz uchun minnatdor bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Muloyim qiling
board: 2) You must come to the meeting.
3) No, I can't do it tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: Uchta qo‘pol gapni ish joyiga mos muloyim shaklga keltiring. Birinchi: faylni yuboring. Ikkinchi: majlisga kelishingiz shart. Uchinchi: yo‘q, ertaga qila olmayman. Har birida yumshatuvchi ibora ishlating.
scenes.say: Make each sentence polite: Send me the file. You must come. No, I can't do it tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni muloyim qiling: faylni yuboring. Kelishingiz shart. Yo‘q, ertaga qila olmayman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Could you send me the file?
2) I'd appreciate it if you could join the meeting.
3) Unfortunately, I won't be able to do it tomorrow. Would Friday work?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “Could you send me the file?” “I'd appreciate it if you could join the meeting.” “Unfortunately, I won't be able to do it tomorrow, but would Friday work?” Oxirgi gapda rad etish bilan birga muqobil taklif ham bor. Bu mutaxassisning eng yaxshi odatlaridan biri: muammo emas, yechim taklif qilish.
scenes.say: Could you send me the file? I'd appreciate it if you could join the meeting. Unfortunately, I won't be able to do it tomorrow. Would Friday work?
scenes.say_uz: Faylni yubora olasizmi? Majlisga qo‘shilsangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. Afsuski, ertaga qila olmayman. Juma qulaymi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: jamoa yig‘ilishi
board: Sara: Can I add something about the budget?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog haftalik yig‘ilishdan. Menejer Mark va hamkasbi Sara loyiha muddati va byudjet haqida gaplashadi. Tinglang: Sara nimadan xavotirda, va ular qaysi qarorga kelishadi? Muloyim iboralarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Let's get started. First, the website launch. Can I add something about the budget? Of course. I see your point, but we have already spent seventy per cent. Unfortunately, we can't hire another designer. Could you possibly check the figures and get back to me by Thursday? Sure. I'll look into it.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlaylik. Avval veb-sayt ishga tushishi. Byudjet haqida qo‘shsam bo‘ladimi? Albatta. Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin biz allaqachon yetmish foizini sarfladik. Afsuski, yana bir dizayner ololmaymiz. Raqamlarni tekshirib, payshanbagacha javob qaytara olasizmi? Albatta. Buni o‘rganib chiqaman.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) What will Sara's colleague do by Thursday?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: Sara nimadan xavotirda? Ikkinchi: ular nimani qila olmaydilar? Uchinchi: payshanbagacha nima qilinadi? Javoblarni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: One: what is Sara worried about? Two: what can't they do? Three: what will happen by Thursday?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Sara nimadan xavotirda? Ikki: ular nima qila olmaydi? Uch: payshanbagacha nima qilinadi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1 javoblari
board: 3) He will check the figures and get back.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: byudjet haqida, yetmish foizi allaqachon sarflangan. Ikkinchi: yana bir dizayner olish imkoni yo‘q. Uchinchi: hamkasb raqamlarni tekshirib, payshanbagacha javob qaytaradi. E’tibor bering, bu yerda look into va get back to phrasal verb lari, “Could you possibly” va “Unfortunately” iboralari mavjud edi.
scenes.say: The budget is the worry. They can't hire another designer. He will check the figures and get back by Thursday.
scenes.say_uz: Xavotir byudjet haqida. Yana dizayner ola olmaydilar. U raqamlarni tekshirib, payshanbagacha javob qaytaradi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i
board: B: I'm calling about my application.
A: Let me put you through.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog telefon orqali. Nomzod ariza haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. Kompaniya xodimi uni kerakli bo‘limga ulaydi. Tinglang: nomzod nima haqida so‘rayapti va unga nima taklif qilinadi?
scenes.say: Good morning, Brightway Limited. How can I help? Good morning. I'm calling about my application for the marketing post. Let me put you through to Human Resources. Hello, Ms Ahmed speaking. I applied last week, and I was wondering if you had received my CV. Yes, we have. You have been shortlisted, and we would like to invite you for an interview on Monday at ten.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, Brightway Limited. Qanday yordam bera olaman? Xayrli tong. Marketing lavozimiga arizam haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapman. Sizni kadrlar bo‘limiga ulayman. Salom, Ahmed xonim eshitadi. O‘tgan hafta ariza topshirgan edim, rezyumemni olganmisiz deb o‘ylagan edim. Ha, olganmiz. Siz qisqa ro‘yxatga kiritilgansiz, dushanba kuni soat o‘nda suhbatga taklif qilamiz.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) Who does the receptionist connect him to?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog savollari. Birinchi: qo‘ng‘iroq qiluvchi nima uchun telefon qildi? Ikkinchi: xodim uni kimga ulaydi? Uchinchi: suhbat qachon? Qisqa javob bering.
scenes.say: One: why is the caller phoning? Two: who is he connected to? Three: when is the interview?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: nega qo‘ng‘iroq qildi? Ikki: kimga ulandi? Uch: suhbat qachon?

scenes.title: Dialog 2 javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: marketing lavozimiga arizasi haqida. Ikkinchi: kadrlar bo‘limi, ya’ni Human Resources. Uchinchi: dushanba kuni soat o‘nda. Telefon iboralarini yozib oling: put someone through, ya’ni ulash, speaking, ya’ni eshitaman, va I'm calling about, ya’ni nima haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qilayotganingizni tushuntirish.
scenes.say: He called about his application. He was put through to Human Resources. The interview is on Monday at ten.
scenes.say_uz: U arizasi haqida qo‘ng‘iroq qildi. U kadrlar bo‘limiga ulandi. Suhbat dushanba kuni soat o‘nda.

scenes.title: Rasmiy elektron xat tuzilmasi
board: Dear Ms Khan, / Dear Sir or Madam,

examples.t: Dear Ms Khan,
I am writing to enquire about the vacancy.
examples.uz: Men vakansiya haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy xat qat’iy tuzilmaga ega. Mavzu qatori qisqa va aniq: “Application for Marketing Manager”. Murojaat: ismni bilsangiz, Dear Ms Khan, bilmasangiz Dear Sir or Madam. Keyin maqsad: “I am writing to ...”, tafsilot va oxirida so‘rov. Britaniyada tugatish: ismni bilsangiz Yours sincerely, bilmasangiz Yours faithfully. Amerikada ko‘pincha Sincerely yoki Best regards. Yozuvda “Mr”dan keyin Britaniyada nuqta qo‘yilmaydi, Amerikada qo‘yiladi.
scenes.say: Dear Ms Khan, I am writing to enquire about the vacancy. Yours sincerely, Alisher Karimov.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli Xon xonim, men vakansiya haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman. Hurmat bilan, Alisher Karimov.

scenes.title: Foydali iboralar
board: I am writing to apply for ...
I would be grateful if you could ...
I look forward to hearing from you.

examples.t: Please find attached my CV.
I would be grateful if you could confirm receipt.

scenes.say_native: Bu iboralar rasmiy xatning qurilish g‘ishtlari. Maqsad: I am writing to apply for. Ilova: Please find attached. Iltimos: I would be grateful if you could, yoki would you mind. Xatni yakunlash: I look forward to hearing from you, bu “javobingizni kutaman” ma’nosida, lekin bosimsiz va muloyim. Britaniyada CV, Amerikada resume deyiladi. Yaxshi xat qisqa bo‘ladi: har bir xatboshi bitta fikr.
scenes.say: Please find attached my CV. I would be grateful if you could confirm receipt. I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_uz: Rezyumem ilova qilingan. Qabul qilinganini tasdiqlasangiz, minnatdor bo‘lardim. Javobingizni intizorlik bilan kutaman.

scenes.title: Norasmiy tilni rasmiy xatda ishlatish
board: ✗ Hi, I wanna ask about the job. Answer ASAP.
✓ Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to enquire about the position.
✗ I am waiting for your answer.
✓ I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy xatda uchta xato tipik. Birinchi: norasmiy so‘zlar, hi, wanna, ASAP, undov belgilari. Ikkinchi: qisqartmalar I'm, don't o‘rniga ba’zan to‘liq shakl yaxshiroq: I am, do not. Uchinchi: “I am waiting for your answer”. O‘zbek “javobingizni kutaman” ning so‘zma-so‘z tarjimasi, ingliz tilida bu bosim kabi eshitiladi, to‘g‘risi “I look forward to hearing from you”. Rasmiy xat tilingizga ishonch bildirsin.
scenes.say: Avoid slang and pressure. Say: I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_uz: Slang va bosimdan qoching. Deng: I look forward to hearing from you.

scenes.title: Rasmiylashtiring
board: 1) Hi! I wanna know about the job.
scenes.say_native: Uchta norasmiy gapni rasmiy xatga mos qilib qayta yozing. Birinchi: salom, ish haqida bilmoqchiman. Ikkinchi: rezyumemni yuboryapman. Uchinchi: tezroq javob bering. Har birida yuqoridagi iboralardan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Rewrite each informal sentence for a formal email.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir norasmiy gapni rasmiy xat uchun qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) I am writing to enquire about the position.
3) I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. “I am writing to enquire about the position.” “Please find attached my CV.” “I look forward to hearing from you.” Uchta gapni ketma-ket qo‘ysangiz, qisqa, ammo to‘liq rasmiy xat asosi hosil bo‘ladi. Oxirida muloyim ibora bilan yakunlashni unutmang. Bir xatda hamma narsa aniq, ixcham va hurmatli bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: I am writing to enquire about the position. Please find attached my CV. I look forward to hearing from you.
scenes.say_uz: Men lavozim haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman. Rezyumem ilova qilingan. Javobingizni intizorlik bilan kutaman.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ish so‘zlarida urg‘u

examples.t: Sales will increase.
There was an increase in sales.

scenes.say_native: Ish lug‘atida urg‘u muhim. Career so‘zida urg‘u oxirida: ca-REER. Colleague birinchi bo‘g‘inda: COL-league. Promotion ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: pro-MO-tion. Ba’zi so‘zlar urg‘u bilan ma’no o‘zgartiradi: ot sifatida INcrease, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, fe’l sifatida inCREASE, urg‘u ikkinchida. Xuddi shunday REcord va reCORD. Schedule so‘zi Britaniyada /ˈʃedjuːl/, Amerikada /ˈskedʒuːl/.
scenes.say: Career, colleague, promotion. The increase was big. Sales will increase.
scenes.say_uz: Career, colleague, promotion. O‘sish katta edi. Sotuv oshadi.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Career, colleague, promotion. Endi ot va fe’lni farqlang: an increase, to increase. Oxirida schedule so‘zini Britaniya va Amerika shaklida ayting. Urg‘u bo‘g‘inini biroz kuchliroq, uzunroq qiling.
scenes.say: Career. Colleague. Promotion. An increase. To increase. Schedule.
scenes.say_uz: Karyera. Hamkasb. Lavozim ko‘tarilishi. O‘sish. Oshirmoq. Jadval.

scenes.title: Izoh
scenes.say_native: Izoh. Urg‘u bosilgan bo‘g‘in kuchli, baland va uzunroq aytiladi, qolganlari esa qisqa va kuchsiz. O‘zbek tilida urg‘u asosan oxirgi bo‘g‘inga tushadi, shuning uchun ingliz so‘zlarida birinchi yoki ikkinchi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u berish alohida odat talab qiladi. Yangi so‘zni o‘rganganda urg‘usini ham birga yodlang.
scenes.say: Stress the right syllable: ca-REER, COL-league, pro-MO-tion.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri bo‘g‘inga urg‘u bering: ca-REER, COL-league, pro-MO-tion.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: karyera haqida gapiring
board: 3) a polite request to a colleague
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Qirq soniya gapiring. Avval hozirgi yoki orzu qilgan kasbingiz haqida ayting. Keyin raqam bilan bitta yutuq. Va oxirida hamkasbga muloyim so‘rov. Kuchli fe’l va kolokatsiyalardan foydalaning. Hozir boshlang.
scenes.say: Tell us about your job or goal. Give one achievement with a number. Finish with a polite request to a colleague.
scenes.say_uz: Kasbingiz yoki maqsadingiz haqida ayting. Raqam bilan bitta yutuq keltiring. Hamkasbga muloyim so‘rov bilan tugating.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I work as a project coordinator.
Could you send me the report?
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “I work as a project coordinator at a logistics company. Last year I reduced delivery times by twenty-five per cent, and I was promoted. My long-term goal is to climb the career ladder to a management post. Could you send me the report by Friday?” Ko‘rdingizmi, bu nutq kolokatsiya, raqam, o‘sish va muloyim so‘rovni o‘z ichiga oladi.
scenes.say: I work as a project coordinator. Last year I reduced delivery times by twenty-five per cent and was promoted. Could you send me the report by Friday?
scenes.say_uz: Men loyiha koordinatori sifatida ishlayman. O‘tgan yili yetkazib berish vaqtini yigirma besh foizga qisqartirdim va lavozimim oshdi. Hisobotni juma kunigacha yubora olasizmi?

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: apply for · get promoted · hand in notice
led · increased by · reduced from ... to
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Job, work, career, position farqi. Kolokatsiyalar: apply for, get promoted, hand in your notice. Yutuqlar uchun kuchli fe’llar va by, to, from. Ish joyidagi muloyim so‘rovlar. Rasmiy xatning tuzilmasi va iboralari. Siz endi o‘zingizni mutaxassis sifatida aniq ifodalay olasiz.
scenes.say: Remember: use strong verbs, precise collocations, polite requests and a clear structure for formal emails.
scenes.say_uz: Eslab qoling: kuchli fe’llar, aniq kolokatsiyalar, muloyim so‘rovlar va rasmiy xat uchun aniq tuzilmadan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingizning karyerangiz haqida 150 so‘zlik xulosa yozing. Kamida uchta kuchli fe’l, bitta raqamli natija va beshta kolokatsiya ishlating. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: matn 140 dan 160 so‘zgacha va hech bir gapda a work yoki responsible of xatosi yo‘q. Keyingi darsda fikrni dalil bilan himoya qilishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is a 150-word career summary. Next time we learn to defend an opinion with evidence.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: 150 so‘zlik karyera xulosasi. Keyingi darsda fikrni dalil bilan himoya qilishni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: O‘z karyerangiz haqida 150 so‘zlik xulosa yozing. Kamida 3 ta kuchli fe’l, 1 ta raqamli natija va 5 ta kolokatsiya ishlating. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: matn 140–160 so‘z, a work yoki responsible of kabi xatolar yo‘q.

options: I have a lot of works.
I have a lot of work.
I have a lot of a work.
quiz.why_uz: Work sanalmaydi: a lot of work.

quiz.q: She ___ for the post last week.
quiz.why_uz: Apply for a post — to‘g‘ri kolokatsiya.

quiz.q: He ___ last year after ten years at the company.
I was ___ for managing the budget.
Which request is the most polite?
options: Would you mind sending me the file?

quiz.q: Which closing is correct for a letter beginning 'Dear Sir or Madam'?
quiz.why_uz: Ismi noma’lum murojaatdan keyin Britaniyada Yours faithfully.

quiz.q: Choose the best ending for a formal email.
options: I am waiting for your answer.
I look forward to hearing from you.
quiz.why_uz: I look forward to hearing from you — muloyim, rasmiy tugatish.
Olmosh ikkala qism orasiga qo‘yiladi: hand it over.

quiz.q: Which word has the stress on the SECOND syllable?
